responsibility: Implements the core Rust macro expansion engine for declarative macros and transcription. This file matches macro invocation token trees against macro_rules! arms, records matched metavariable fragments, expands eager nested invocations for builtins, substitutes matched fragments into transcriber token streams through SubstituteCtx, reparses the substituted tokens with MacroInvocLexer in the appropriate context (item, trait item, impl item, extern item, type, statement, or expression), and produces AST::Fragment results while enforcing delimiter, semicolon, and parse-error handling for the expansion stage.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file is where MacroExpander's declared machinery is executed: it matches macro_rules! arms, expands eager nested invocations, drives SubstituteCtx and MacroInvocLexer, reparses substituted tokens by context, and checks delimiter/leftover-token conditions. The header holds the data structures and method declarations for that engine.
